params.body:
Withdraw the Nederland Mobiel adverts of cars that are gone here.

## Why

On 30 September 2026 production held 97 cars (deleted ones included) still flagged `is_on_nederland_mobiel` while deleted or sold: 95 distinct adverts across 36 dealers. A liveness check on belgiemobiel.be found 61 of those adverts still live and 33 already gone. 32 of the live ones belong to cars deleted between 16 and 21 September 2026, when the removal hung on the Nederland Mobiel cURL call without a timeout (fixed in #840); 20 are older (old platform, 2023 to June 2026); 9 are sold but never deleted. Several cars can share one advert: dealer 444 had three cars deleted on 25 June 2026 that all point to advert 22365180.

`stocklist:resend-removals` deliberately left Nederland Mobiel alone; this is the command for that half.

## What

`php artisan stocklist:nederland-mobiel-orphans [--vehicle=*] [--dealer=*] [--apply] [--pause=1]`

- Selection: `Vehicle::withTrashed()`, `is_on_nederland_mobiel = 1`, and deleted or `sold = 1`. A car is skipped when a live car (not deleted, not sold, flagged) carries the same non-empty `nederland_mobiel_url`: that advert still belongs to a car on sale.
- Default is a dry run: one line per car (id, dealer id and name, deleted or sold date, advert url) and a summary (cars, distinct adverts, dealers). Nothing leaves.
- `--apply` calls the existing `OwnStockService::removeFromNederlandMobiel($vehicle)` per car, the same path the observer uses, with `--pause` seconds between calls, and prints per car whether it was withdrawn plus `last_nederland_mobiel_response`. A car still flagged afterwards fails the run (exit 1).
- The seal applies: without `nederlandmobiel` in `OUTBOUND_IMPACT` outside production, `--apply` says so and stops before the first call.

`OwnStockService`, `XML`, the observer and the publisher are untouched.

## Docs

- `ResendRemovals` docblock points to the new command.
- R P3-5.12 lists the command; R S2-10.14 refers to it.
- Finding `bevinding: verwijderde-wagens-blijven-op-nederland-mobiel`, status opgelost.

## Tests

`NederlandMobielOrphansTest` (`@rule P3-5.3`, `@rule P3-5.12`), `OwnStockService` always mocked so no cURL can leave: the dry run lists deleted and sold cars and sends nothing; a deleted car sharing its advert with a live car is excluded; `--apply` withdraws each selected car once and prints the answer; a car still flagged after the call fails the run; a sealed environment sends nothing. Checked that the exclusion and seal tests fail when those lines are mutated. Full suite green locally (2415 tests), PHPStan clean, pint on the new files.

After merge, on production: run the dry run first, compare with the 61 live adverts, then `--apply`.
params.title: Withdraw the Nederland Mobiel adverts of cars that are gone here
